DIAGNOSIS READY: Major Depressive Disorder with Psychotic Features (Melancholic features).

The patient is a 23-year-old female presenting with a 4-month history of persistent sadness, significant weight loss, insomnia, and functional impairment. She also reports auditory hallucinations (voices telling her she is worthless) that have been present for 7 months, which began before the onset of the depressive episode. Given the duration of mood symptoms (>2 weeks) and the presence of psychotic features without a history of mania, this aligns with Major Depressive Disorder with psychotic features. Do you have any history of substance use or prior psychiatric treatment? REQUEST TEST: Thyroid_Stimulation_Hormone (TSH) and Comprehensive_Metabolic_Panel to rule out organic causes.
